stageNotes.stage1_canonical: Both apex and www return 200 on Chrome 120 desktop UA. Homepage `<link rel="canonical" href="https://kodiakdefence.com/">` declares apex as canonical. No hreflang. nginx server tier.
stageNotes.stage2_waf: Heavy-8-batch probe: nginx server, no cf-ray, no x-sucuri, no malcare/wordfence body markers. BUT extended probe found Imunify360 challenges every interior path beyond `/` (e.g. `/shop/`, `/product-category/firearms/`, `/wp-json/...`, `/?s=glock` all return 200 + 4744-byte 'One moment, please...' JS-reload interstitial). API paths return 200 + JSON access-denied body `{"message":"Access denied by Imunify360 bot-protection. IPs used for automation should be whitelisted"}`. The standard 8-batch probe missed this because it only fingerprints `/` + honeypots. Imunify360 is a NEW wafType for this codebase (no existing handler). Runtime: production WC adapter calls ensureCookies() -> Playwright solves challenge on homepage (~6-7s) -> cookies cached in Redis (90 min TTL) -> subsequent fetches succeed.

auditNotes.extractionAdapterGap: CRITICAL OPERATOR ACTION: WC adapter `extractCatalogProducts` SELECTORS array at backend/src/services/scraper/adapters/woocommerce.ts:648-657 does NOT match KDC product cards. KDC wraps each product in `<article class="post-N type-product product_cat-... ">` nested inside `<div class="wf-cell">`. The existing 8 selectors target `li.product`, `.wd-product`, `.product-small`, `div[class*="product"][class*="type-product"]`, etc. — none match `<article>`. Recommended fix: add `'article[class*="type-product"]'` to the SELECTORS array. Without this, runtime catalog walk via HTML returns 0 products even after Playwright solves the Imunify360 challenge -> bootstrap stalls indefinitely. The WC Store API path (used for maintain verify + watermark) does NOT depend on these selectors and will work as-is.
auditNotes.imunify360Note: NEW WAF TYPE for this codebase — no existing wafType-specific handler. Pattern: HTML interstitial title 'One moment, please...', body contains <script>setTimeout(window.location.reload, 5000)</script>. Cookies NOT set on interstitial; cleared by browser context after challenge solve via Playwright. JSON API paths (`/wp-json/...`) before challenge return `Access denied by Imunify360 bot-protection` body with HTTP 200. The existing waf-cookie-manager.ts Playwright-warm-up-then-cache pattern works as-is (verified live: homepage goto with networkidle solves the challenge, then in-page fetch() against /wp-json/wc/store/v1/products returns full data). Catalog-crawler.ts:418-426 already has a 'isBlocked' check that triggers Playwright when html<2000 bytes OR specific markers match — KDC interstitial is 4744 bytes and contains neither 'Just a moment' nor 'Access Denied' literal, so the isBlocked check WILL NOT trigger. Production runtime depends on `hasWaf=true` to route through ensureCookies() in the WC adapter (woocommerce.ts:35-43) — that path works. Operator MAY consider adding 'One moment, please' to the isBlocked regex at catalog-crawler.ts:419 for defense-in-depth.
